title: 平畴交远风 Pingchou Jiao Yuanfeng
subtitle: Changchun Yuan

model.line: 1 boxes stand in this compound, 1 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 平畴交远风
evidence.excerpt_zh: 愛山樓東北為平疇交逺風南為轉湘帆（長春園册）臣等謹案平疇交逺風宇後額曰平皋綠浄聯曰畏民碞其難其慎敕天命惟㡬惟康
evidence.summary: North-east of 愛山樓: 平疇交逺風, with 轉湘帆 to the south and a rear plaque 平皋綠浄.

evidence.title: 圆明园景点建筑命名对古代文学遗产的继承与发展
evidence.summary: How scene and hall names come from literature: 上下天光 from 范仲淹, 杏花春馆 from 杜牧, 武陵春色 from 陶渊明, 坐石临流 from 兰亭, and 丰乐轩 and 顺木天 from 柳宗元. It also quotes the 陶渊明 line 平畴交远风. It places 丰乐轩, three bays facing north, in the 紫碧山房 scene.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Its place is drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), with no name written.

facts.label: Plan reader's note
facts.value: 9-bay B0226 with a walled court south of it, small south gate (11535,1403). No label. Rixia: 平畴交远风 is north-east of 爱山楼, and 丛芳榭 is east of it: fits this hall, next before the 琴清斋 group. Alternative is B0225 at (10937,1407), see NEW-cc_xyl-02.
